name: ulims-json-schemas
description: Primary JSON Schemas for ULIMS projects.

scripts.build-main-diff: for fn in $(git diff --name-only origin/main --diff-filter=ACM -- *current.json); do npm run build-new $fn; done
scripts.find-modified: ! git diff --name-status --diff-filter=M origin/main | awk '{print $2}' | grep -e 'schemas/.*.json' | grep -v 'current.json'
scripts.fail-shared-no-underscore-gh: FOUND=$(find ./schemas -type d -name "shared" | awk '{printf "%s%s", sep, $0; sep=" | "}'); if [ -n "$FOUND" ]; then echo "::error::Found 'shared' folder inside schemas (must be renamed to '_shared' and schema refs updated), use npm run fail-shared-no-underscore locally to see if fixed. Found: $FOUND"; exit 1; fi
